title: talentframe
summary: TalentFrameUiLaw now owns the current 384x512 shell, portrait, class-background quadrants, 264x20 points border, 296x332 ScrollFrame with fixed 504px child, exact 172px range and 20px step, 8x4/63px talent grid, tabs and close controls. It also owns portrait and scrollbar UVs, scroll offset/knob projection, measured points-spent placement, tab positioning, and each talent tooltip's authored ANCHOR_RIGHT seat; GameLoop.Talents contains no local Vector2 geometry. The renderer uses the exact TalentBranches/TalentArrows atlas cells for prerequisite routing instead of generic lines, restores the Quickslot2 talent-button layer, hides locked zero-rank badges, shows the reference rank number rather than an invented rank/max fraction, and uses the exact enabled/locked/maxed tints. Talent hover now follows SetTalent's shared classic tooltip shape: white spell name and rank line, ordered red tier/required-spell/prerequisite requirements, the current spell body, gold next-rank description, and the independently gated green learn hint. Existing talent eligibility, CMSG_LEARN_TALENT, server confirmation observation, wipe confirmation, portrait and class tree backgrounds remain. Focused and full desktop clinical suites pass; live visual/input acceptance remains.

openItems.text: TalentFrame used a 103px scroll cap and 150px arrow jumps instead of the current fixed 172px/20px law, omitted the points border and Quickslot2 layer, drew invented rank/max badges on locked talents, and represented prerequisites as generic straight lines rather than the authored branch/arrow atlas.
openItems.resolution: TalentFrameUiLaw owns the corrected geometry, fixed range/step, button layers/rank visibility and deterministic port of TalentFrame_DrawLines plus atlas paint. The renderer consumes those rules and focused/full desktop clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify every class tree at top/bottom scroll limits: points border/text, three fitted tabs, all eight tiers reachable in 20px steps, lit/gray prerequisite atlas routes and arrows, locked/spent/maxed button layers and rank badges, click eligibility, tooltip placement, both close controls, and the conditional talent-wipe action.
Talent tooltips used ImGui's implicit cursor placement instead of TalentButtonTemplate's ANCHOR_RIGHT owner seat.
openItems.resolution: TalentFrameUiLaw maps each talent button TOPRIGHT to the tooltip BOTTOMLEFT, and the renderer applies that seat before opening the tooltip.

openItems.text: Talent hover used a generic ImGui tooltip containing only the name, rank fraction, and an internal eligibility token instead of Benilla's SetTalent spell-builder content and classic tooltip presentation.
openItems.resolution: TalentFrameUiLaw now owns the exact SetTalent row interleave, requirement wording/order, white/gold/red/green colors, learn-hint gate, and owner-right origin. The window publishes through shared GameTooltip arbitration and paints the current spell body plus next-rank description without changing the protected Spellbook tooltip path. Focused TalentFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.
